headword: {人権活動|じんけんかつどう}
gloss: human rights activities; human rights work

definitions.gloss: human rights activities; human rights work
definitions.explanation: Organized activities aimed at promoting, protecting, or advocating for the rights and dignity of individuals. Includes activism, education, legal advocacy, and awareness campaigns.

examples.japanese: {人権活動|じんけんかつどう}に{取|と}り{組|く}む。
examples.english: To engage in human rights activities.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{長年|ながねん}{人権活動|じんけんかつどう}を{続|つづ}けてきた。
examples.english: She has continued her human rights work for many years.

examples.japanese: その{NGO|えぬじーおー}は{難民|なんみん}への{支援|しえん}を{中心|ちゅうしん}とした{人権活動|じんけんかつどう}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: That NGO conducts human rights activities centered on support for refugees.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人権活動|じんけんかつどう}{家|か}: human rights activist
- {人権活動|じんけんかつどう}に{関|かか}わる: to be involved in human rights work
- {国際的|こくさいてき}な{人権活動|じんけんかつどう}: international human rights activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人権運動|じんけんうんどう}: human rights movement (broader, more organized)
- {人権擁護|じんけんようご}: protection of human rights
